content: crypto-js README states development is DISCONTINUED and the library is no longer maintained (repo not archived, last push Aug 2024). GHSA-rg76-677x-56q9 / CVE-2026-71851: CryptoJS.lib.WordArray.random() in <4.0.0 is a weak PRNG (Ill Bloom). Spec already mandates expo-crypto for salt/IV/randomUUID, which avoids the advisory; remaining concern is pure-JS PBKDF2-SHA256 at 210k iterations blocking the JS thread for seconds on mid-range phones.
